question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — National Wildlife Refuge System Invasive Species Strike Team Act (H R 4219)
bill_title: National Wildlife Refuge System Invasive Species Strike Team Act of 2025
plain_language: This bill writes into law the wildlife-refuge teams that fight invasive species and requires a report to Congress. A two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — American Battlefield Protection Program Amendments Act (H R 7618)
bill_title: American Battlefield Protection Program Amendments Act of 2026
plain_language: This bill extends through FY2036 three National Park Service grant programs that preserve U.S. battlefields and requires the NPS to study additional sites for potential preservation. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Passage — Make the District of Columbia Safe and Beautiful Act (H R 5103)
bill_title: Make the District of Columbia Safe and Beautiful Act of 2025
plain_language: This bill establishes a commission in the executive branch to advise on certain criminal and immigration matters in the District of Columbia. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Recommit — Make the District of Columbia Safe and Beautiful Act (H R 5103)
bill_title: Make the District of Columbia Safe and Beautiful Act of 2025
plain_language: H.R. 5103 (Make the District of Columbia Safe and Beautiful Act of 2025) establishes a commission in the executive branch to advise on certain criminal and immigration matters in the District of Columbia. A motion to recommit is the minority's last formal chance to send a bill back to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it back; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.

question: On Passage — Protecting Access for Hunters and Anglers Act (H R 556)
bill_title: Protecting Access for Hunters and Anglers Act
plain_language: This bill bars the Fish and Wildlife Service, the Bureau of Land Management, and the Forest Service from prohibiting or regulating the use of lead ammunition or tackle on federal land or water. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — MAWS Act (H R 4294)
plain_language: This bill requires the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration to establish a pilot program to facilitate the purchase of blue catfish caught within the Chesapeake Bay Watershed. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Passage — Undersea Cable Protection Act (H R 261)
plain_language: This bill prohibits the Department of Commerce from enforcing certain permit requirements for activities related to undersea fiber optic cables in national marine sanctuaries. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Passage — Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management relating to Public Land Order No. 7917 for Withdrawal of Federal Lands; Cook, Lake, and Saint Louis Counties, MN (H J RES 140)
bill_title: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management relating to Public Land Order No. 7917 for Withdrawal of Federal Lands; Cook, Lake, and Saint Louis Counties, MN.
plain_language: This joint resolution opens approximately 225,504 acres of National Forest System lands in Cook, Lake, and Saint Louis Counties in Minnesota to mineral and geothermal leasing. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.
